mentions.name: Real Estate Listing Description Generator
mentions.description: This AI-powered SaaS generates professional real estate listing descriptions in about 30 seconds. It analyzes listing photos to pull out key features an agent might miss and adds neighborhood context such as walkability score. Recently launched as a standalone product.
mentions.problem: Real estate agents spend 45+ minutes per listing staring at a blank screen trying to make basic property details like "3BR/2BA ranch" sound compelling.
mentions.audience: Real estate agents and the broader real estate industry.
mentions.author: wjr
